fields.statement: QA at dfd42a2b: a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) ran a real long-running rhiza daemon (paused, --max-runs 0) in a fresh scratch repo with the run env unset, and curl hit it. With rhiza.web.port unset the daemon listened on 127.0.0.1:7787 only (ss) and GET / gave 200. rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.port rejected 0, 70000 and abc (must be a port number from 1 to 65535, or off) and accepted 18787. With the daemon running, setting 18788, then off, then 18787 moved, stopped and restarted the listener within 4-5 s each (ss shows only 127.0.0.1:<port>). A port already held by another process was logged (bind: address already in use), the daemon stayed up and bound it once freed. strace -e bind shows rhiza daemon --once and a long-running daemon with RHIZA_TEST_NOW set make no bind call.

QA at dfd42a2b: a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) ran a real long-running rhiza daemon (paused, --max-runs 0) in a fresh scratch repo with the run env unset, and curl hit it. GET /api/run.ls, /api/roadmap, /api/ls and /api/status were byte-identical (cmp) to rhiza run ls/roadmap/ls/status --json; ?limit=1 was honoured, ?bogus=1 gave 400 with a usage error, HEAD /api/ls 200. GET /api/land, accept, daemon.set, daemon.start, render, ship.merge, add, apply and change.new all gave 404; POST, PUT, DELETE and PATCH on /api/run.ls gave 405.

QA at dfd42a2b: a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) ran a real long-running rhiza daemon (paused, --max-runs 0) in a fresh scratch repo with the run env unset, and curl hit it. curl -N /events answered text/event-stream with a ready comment and keep-alives. rhiza add to an existing change set and rhiza change new each produced event: change with that change set ID; toggling rhiza.daemon.paused produced event: daemon; raising rhiza.daemon.minFree to 1000T raised a disk-low inbox item and an event: inbox, and lowering it back sent event: inbox again as the item left. Run journal and driver log events were not exercised hands-on (no agent run was started); the package test covers them.

QA at dfd42a2b: a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) ran a real long-running rhiza daemon (paused, --max-runs 0) in a fresh scratch repo with the run env unset, and curl hit it. GET / gave 200 text/html with the rendered Overview layout (header, nav, stale banner, /static/app.js). /static/app.js (text/javascript), /static/css/rhiza-tokens.css and rhiza.css (text/css), favicon.svg and .ico, a woff2 font and /site.webmanifest were all served from the binary with no files on disk beside it.

QA at dfd42a2b: a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) ran a real long-running rhiza daemon (paused, --max-runs 0) in a fresh scratch repo with the run env unset, and curl hit it. After rhiza daemon --once with the setting unset, rhiza daemon status showed Web UI: http://127.0.0.1:7787 and --json web http://127.0.0.1:7787; after rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.port off and another --once it showed Web UI: off and web off. A running daemon status followed the 18787, 18788 and off moves.

QA at dfd42a2b: a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) ran a real long-running rhiza daemon (paused, --max-runs 0) in a fresh scratch repo with the run env unset, and curl hit it. /static/app.js is served, subscribes to /events, swaps sections by data-rz-events and data-rz-fragment, and toggles is-stale and the #rz-stale banner when the stream drops; the rendered page carries the #rz-stale banner. /fragments/nope gave 404. No page yet declares a live section, so no swap was seen in a browser (the leaf asks for no browser test).
